name: Agent editor Context tab renders the project-context attach panel
description: Opens the seeded Test Quality Reviewer and switches to its Context tab. Guards the reachability of the tab, not just its existence: the tab button and the ?tab= whitelist on /agents/[id]/page.tsx are two separate places, and when they disagreed the button rendered, the URL changed to tab=context, and the editor silently fell back to Config. So asserting the URL alone is not enough — the last step asserts on copy that only ContextAttachPanel renders.

steps.label: switch to the Context tab (the Tabs kit renders plain buttons, not role=tab)
tab state is in the URL
the attach panel's order hint is visible — Config renders no such copy
